title: Erroneous deployment and rollback
summary: Release 2.14.0 shipped a regression that raised API errors and page-load times. Disabling the checkout.v2 flag masked most of it; a full rollback to 2.13.8 restored baseline.

events.message: NullPointerException in CheckoutController (new code path in 2.14.0)
Partial recovery — flagged traffic on legacy path
